text: Bitcoin's outperformance (+4.9% vs Ethereum's +2.3%) alongside a jump to Extreme Greed and rising BTC dominance (58.8%) suggests traders are rotating toward the largest cap asset and away from altcoins. The $159B daily volume and sharp 9-point rise in Fear & Greed over a week indicate sustained conviction rather than a spike-and-fade move, though the extreme reading leaves limited room for momentum surprises upward.
